title: Your guide has a “new payment account”
scenario: The guide from yesterday’s walking tour messages you by WhatsApp and offers a private day trip at a good price. The profile photo and chat history are familiar, but payment must go to a different name because “the company account is locked.”

answers.A: Ask the guide a detail from yesterday that was not posted publicly, then pay only through the original platform if available.
answers.B: Pay the new account because the existing chat history proves it is the same person.
answers.C: Contact the tour company or guide through the original booking platform and confirm both the offer and payment destination.

explanation: A familiar account can be taken over. Payment destination changes are a high-value moment to re-verify identity.
proTip: Old chat history does not guarantee the account still has its old owner.
